context.decisionSummary: Dev.101 follows published dev.100. Joel supplied three Frontier screenshots and requested map-edge channel continuity, replacement of the detached dark strip with a polished civic fountain, and new leaves on burned trees. He then requested longer enemy specials with matching warnings/effects, slightly greater targeting distance to balance all ranged party members, earlier recognition of losing fights, and healing for wounded enemies arriving to regroup. A fourth screenshot requests a preview of paired violet bows on the Mage's braids; that preview is unselected and is not applied to the runtime.
